## Instructions

Run the task-work skill in loop mode:

```
$kspec-task-work loop
```

Loop mode means: no confirmations, auto-resolve decisions, automation-eligible tasks only.

**Normal flow:** Work on a task, create a PR, then stop responding. Ralph continues automatically —
it checks for remaining eligible tasks at the start of each iteration and exits the loop itself when none remain.

**Do NOT call `end-loop` after completing a task.** Simply stop responding.
`end-loop` is a rare escape hatch for when work is stalling across multiple iterations with no progress — not a normal exit path.

  "notes": [
    {
      "_ulid": "01KJDQC6EMCTTQFKDBQX9JCG55",
      "created_at": "2026-02-26T19:38:54.292Z",
      "author": "@claude",
      "content": "ENRICHMENT — Standalone context for this task:\n\n**What**: The Web UI WebSocket connection continually disconnects and reconnects. The `WebSocketManager` in `packages/web-ui/src/lib/websocket/manager.ts` has exponential backoff reconnection (1s, 2s, 4s... max 30s, max 10 attempts), but users report seeing frequent disconnect/reconnect cycles in the console logs. This suggests either the server is closing connections, the keepalive/heartbeat mechanism is missing, or reconnection resets are happening incorrectly.\n\n**Where**:\n- `packages/web-ui/src/lib/websocket/manager.ts` — The WebSocketManager class. Key areas:\n  - `connect()` (line 150): creates WebSocket, sets up onopen/onmessage/onerror/onclose handlers\n  - `scheduleReconnect()` (line 371): exponential backoff logic, max 10 attempts\n  - `onclose` handler (line 183): triggers reconnect on any close event, even clean ones\n  - No heartbeat/ping mechanism — if the server expects periodic pings, the connection may time out\n- `packages/web-ui/src/lib/stores/connection.svelte.ts` — Connection store wrapping the manager\n- Server-side WebSocket handler (in the daemon code) — check if it sends pings or has idle timeouts\n\n**How**: Investigation and fix areas:\n1. **Add heartbeat/ping**: Implement a periodic ping from client to server (e.g., every 30s). Many WebSocket servers close idle connections after a timeout (often 60s). The client should send a ping command and expect a pong response.\n2. **Don't reconnect on clean close**: The `onclose` handler (line 183) calls `scheduleReconnect()` unconditionally. If `event.code === 1000` (normal closure) and the client initiated it via `disconnect()`, skip reconnection. Currently `disconnect()` clears the timer, but there's a race if onclose fires after disconnect resets state.\n3. **Check server-side idle timeout**: The daemon's WebSocket server may have an idle timeout that closes connections. Either increase it or implement heartbeat to keep alive.\n4. **Consider connection health check**: After reconnecting, verify the connection is actually healthy (e.g., send a ping and wait for response) before transitioning to 'connected' state.\n5. **Investigate MAX_RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS**: After 10 failed reconnects, the connection is abandoned permanently. Consider resetting the attempt counter after a successful connection that lasts longer than some threshold (e.g., 60s).\n\n**Done when**:\n- WebSocket connection remains stable for extended periods without spurious disconnects\n- Client sends periodic heartbeat/ping to prevent idle timeout\n- Clean disconnects (code 1000 from client-initiated disconnect) don't trigger reconnection\n- Console shows clean connection lifecycle without repeated disconnect/reconnect spam\n- Connection lost indicator (10s threshold) only triggers for genuine server unavailability\n- Tests cover: heartbeat keeps connection alive, clean close doesn't reconnect, reconnection works after genuine server restart",
      "supersedes": null,
      "superseded": false
    },
    {
      "_ulid": "01KJDQX0Y1T915X3M23D1VS9PP",
      "created_at": "2026-02-26T19:48:05.698Z",
      "author": "@claude",
      "content": "Linked to @daemon-server spec (covers WebSocket protocol). Investigate and fix WebSocket reconnection reliability.",
      "supersedes": null,
      "superseded": false
    },
    {
      "_ulid": "01KJM2DPN621APMNNFFZCX3RN5",
      "created_at": "2026-03-01T06:47:24.582Z",
      "author": "Jacob Chapel",
      "content": "Execution context:\n- Background: Web UI websocket manager can enter reconnect churn due to stale onclose handlers from prior sockets and reconnect attempts after intentional disconnect.\n- Scope: stabilize client connection lifecycle for intentional close and project-switch reconnects; add focused regression tests for stale-close and manual-disconnect behavior.\n- Files: packages/web-ui/src/lib/websocket/manager.ts, tests/web-ui/websocket-manager.test.ts (new).\n- Verification: run targeted vitest for websocket manager tests and relevant existing connection-related tests, then run full npm test before submit.",
      "supersedes": null,
      "superseded": false
    },
    {
      "_ulid": "01KJM2R4EQV8T6WJV405GP3XWQ",
      "created_at": "2026-03-01T06:53:06.391Z",
      "author": "Jacob Chapel",
      "content": "Implemented WebSocket reconnect-stability fix in packages/web-ui/src/lib/websocket/manager.ts and added regression tests in tests/websocket-manager.test.ts.\n\nWhat changed:\n- Added stale-socket guards in connect() event handlers so late events from old sockets are ignored and cannot null out the active connection.\n- Added intentionalDisconnect tracking so manual disconnects do not schedule reconnect attempts.\n- Updated disconnect() to detach current socket reference before close, preventing close-handler races with new connections.\n- Added regression tests for:\n  1) old-socket close after project switch does not disrupt active socket,\n  2) intentional disconnect does not auto-reconnect,\n  3) unexpected disconnect still triggers reconnect.\n\nVerification:\n- npx vitest run tests/websocket-manager.test.ts (3 passed)\n- npm test (fails on pre-existing baseline issues unrelated to this change):\n  - tests/cli-serve.test.ts \"should show No projects registered when no projects exist\"\n  - tests/cli/session-note-limit.test.ts timeout failures (2 cases)\n- kspec validate (pre-existing project-wide schema/reference/alignment/completeness issues)",
